title: Midnight Knafeh
description: A dessert version of the Middle Eastern cheese pastry, adapted for a midnight treat. Knafeh is typically filled with cheese, but we'll use a sweet variation here.

ingredients.name: Nourish
ingredients.notes: Chopped pistachios add a crunchy texture

ingredients.name: Knafeh
ingredients.notes: A sweet variation of the traditional cheese used in knafeh

instructions: Thaw the Midnight and separate the dough into individual sheets.
In a large bowl, mix together the Nourish and Knafeh.
Layer the Midnight dough in a baking dish, creating a crust.
Pour the Nourish-Knafeh mixture on top of the dough.
Repeat the layering process, finishing with a layer of Midnight.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
Cut into diamond shapes and serve immediately.
